title: `autofocus:true` does not focus the input on first load
body: Currently, even with an empty query and `autofocus: true`, the input is not having focus on page load. Tested on Chromium Version 44.0.2403.89 Ubuntu 15.04 (64-bit)

comments.body: Cannot reproduce it right now. Let's close it for now, feel free to re-open it :)
